objective1.title: Extent of Coverage and Access to Urban Transport

focusAreas.name: Policy, Plans, Institutional Mechanism & Finance
findings: CMP- Prepared (but not integrated); Not finalized/notified; Not updated
TOD- Notified; Included in master plan; Not notified
Urban Transport Fund- Created; Not created; Low utilization of fund

focusAreas.name: Accessibility & Infrastructure
findings: Assessment done in silos; Limited dynamic route rationalization
Shortage of city buses; Sub-optimal fleet utilization; Absence of PT in peripheral area
No organised IPT and Feeder Buses; High Dependence on IPT
Lack of Multimodal Integration; CMC not operationalised

focusAreas.name: Affordability & Comfort
findings: Fare disparity; Weak regulation of IPT fare
Absence of directional signages; No real time Passenger Information System
Lack of passenger amenities
GRM- Available; Lack of awareness

focusAreas.name: Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) / ICCC
findings: Real-time passenger demand tracking app available; ICCC not fully operationalised
Punctuality data not monitored, not disclosed
ITS integration not done; Limited ITS enabled buses

focusAreas.name: Traffic Management
findings: Personnel deployment – insufficient, junction-based
Low rate of traffic signal synchronisation; Traffic signals switched off at peak hours
No dedicated lanes, inadequate road marking

focusAreas.name: Parking Policies & Enforcement
findings: No provisions for parking in building byelaws
Unrealised parking fees and user charges
Limited/No multi-level parking
Congestion charging not fully implemented

focusAreas.name: Sustainable Urban Transport
findings: Non preparation of action plans; Non availing Central/State Assistance
Slow progress of alternate fuel/ EV adoption
Lack of EV charging infrastructure
Unavailable sustainable last mile connectivity
Inadequate enforcement of emission control measures; Non availability of IT enabled system

focusAreas.name: Non-Motorised Transport (NMT)
findings: Insufficient dedicated walking/ cycling space
Non achievement of NMT network targets
Encroached/ Discontinuous footpaths & cycling tracks
Lack of inclusive and universal accessible NMT infrastructure

focusAreas.name: Safety Infrastructure
findings: Deviations from design standards
Signages and markings not consistently provided
Insufficient lighting on pedestrian paths
CCTVs not integrated with ICCC

focusAreas.name: Processes & Institutional Mechanism
findings: Gaps in regulatory and enforcement mechanism
Irregular meetings and limited systematic review
Lack of periodic inspections of vehicles
Non-regular safety audits
Unstructured awareness campaigns
